European stock markets closed higher on Friday as dropping oil prices brought relief following several volatile sessions. Despite the late-week recovery, regional benchmarks logged severe weekly losses, with the pan-European STOXX 600 index dropping more than one and a half percent overall.

European Central Bank implements interest rate hike to combat rising energy costs
The European Central Bank increased its primary interest rates by 25 basis points in response to an inflation outlook worsened by geopolitical instability. While the bank left its 2026 inflation estimate stable at 3 percent, officials indicated that consumer price pressures could remain above target for longer than previously projected.

Global bond selloff pushes eurozone sovereign debt yields toward historic highs
Fixed income markets have experienced significant volatility, pushing government bond yields across the continent higher. Benchmark German 10-year yields hovered near multi-decade peaks as investors priced in a tighter monetary policy stance in both Europe and the United States.

French financial assets face pressure amid rising fiscal deficit worries
The CAC 40 index managed a modest recovery on Friday, even as market participants weighed deteriorating conditions in France's public finances. The nation's finance minister acknowledged that the country risks failing to hit its deficit reduction targets after lowering its broader economic growth projections.
